title: Rework how SUPPORT360_TICKET.RAISED_BY_NAME is populated: resolve it from the lo
description:
Here is the earlier plan again.

(a) Step 1, for tickets that already exist: For every ticket where the “raised by name” (RAISED_BY_NAME) is empty, fill it in once. Right now the plan copies the long user ID (RAISED_BY, like 97b79196…) into it. I don’t want the ID. I want the person’s email.

(b) Step 3, for new tickets: When a ticket is saved, find the logged-in person’s email and save it as RAISED_BY_NAME in the same save. If the email cannot be found, keep the ID instead.

What I need: Use the same method for both (a) and (b). Look up the email from the user directory (the same list of users that the system keeps for people who log in), using the saved user ID. Do not look it up from the Agent Master. Create Ticket already shows the email on screen, so use the same source it uses. If the email cannot be found, keep the ID.

Please do not change anything else.

todos.label: Update FRS: RAISED_BY_NAME now stores resolved email, not display name
Rewrite resolve_raised_by_name to resolve EMAIL from the user/session directory, not the Agent master
Move raised_by_name resolution from on-add to pre_commit on support360_create_ticket
Register the one-time backfill process in navigation
Create the backfill General Process model
Add the backfill process's email-resolution function
